scope: MT202/MT202COV/MT205/MT205COV and pacs.009 plain/COV/ADV routing guard
oracles: Profile is selected by governed scenario and BAH BizSvc, never MsgDefIdr or MT code alone
MT option, omission, source MT type, Sequence A/B, account identity and UETR remain semantically stable
Selected operational account uses accountReference and never maskedAccountRef fallback
DEVELOPMENT/DEMO data-quality failure is HTTP 409; non-development is HTTP 500; neither generates payload, confirmed resolution or Repair Queue
ADV is a non-settlement routing guard and must not create a settlement posting
acceptanceRule: Every command must have a current machine-readable report and every oracle must be asserted; this manifest alone is not execution evidence.
